scholarships.name: Postgraduate/Master’s Study Grant
scholarships.description: Students in the UAE are eligible for 10% Study Grant on all postgraduate programmes. Students choosing to study the Executive MBA, MBA (Daytime Delivery) or the MA Human Resource Management programme are eligible for a 20% Professional Study Grant.

scholarships.name: Professional Study Grant
scholarships.description: Students in the UAE choosing to study the Executive MBA, MBA (Daytime Delivery) or the MA Human Resource Management programme are eligible for a 20% Professional Study Grant.

scholarships.name: Alumni Study Grant
scholarships.description: All MDX alumni receive a 25% Alumni Study Grant if they choose to enrol in further studies.

scholarships.name: Teacher Study Grant
scholarships.description: Teachers and school staff in the UAE and worldwide can receive a 25% Study Grant for our Education programmes, or 20% for all other postgraduate programmes.

scholarships.name: Team Middlesex Sporting Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Team Middlesex Sporting Excellence Scholarship is awarded to applicants who are excelling in the sporting world, demonstrating aptitude in their sports and academic performance prior to joining the university.
